description: Search locations with filters, sorting, and pagination.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

companyId.description: Company / agency ID to search within

filters.description: Array of filter objects to narrow results

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

orderBy.description: Field name to sort results by

skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

name: crm_search_locations
